description: T-3820: which character after a capital sigma makes LOWER (and PROPER) give the medial sigma. Data!A<n> = UNICHAR(913)&UNICHAR(931)&<char> (label in Data!B), rows 1..50; Calc!A<n> = UNICODE of LOWER's 2nd character (962 final, 963 medial), B the same over PROPER, C = LEN(TEXTBEFORE("x"&text, medial sigma, 1, 1)) or -1. Calc!E1:E256 (LOWER) and F1:F256 (PROPER): BMP sweep, E(p+1) covers U+p00..U+pFF with the next character, one digit per code point: 1 medial, 0 final, x other, e UNICHAR error.
